model: ROLEX Explorer 40 224270 (40 mm steel, black dial, smooth domed polished bezel, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). ADAPTED from the Rolex Air-King template (config rolex-airking-126900; same step pipeline/steps/watch_rolex_airking.py, read-only): case slab from the alpha silhouette (lugs, no crown guards on the Explorer) between the end-link tips, domed polished bezel ring (ellipse outer edge, crest 1 mm inside it, fitted circular window edge, chamfer), flat polygon dial with the native photo map (print, minute track, 3 / 6 / 9 numerals, triangle at 12, rehaut ring and the photographed hands stay in the map), one fluted crown, Oyster bracelet = brushed outer-link rows + centre-link pieces from the trace, hands = traced photo outlines (Mercedes hour hand, sword minute hand, seconds with tail disc and lume head disc). Measured on the 224270 photo at 40 mm (scale 22.245 px/mm); tips, hands, hub, crown, bracelet and emissions are per photo. The photo's lighting is baked into the maps (emission), specular is zero on every photo part.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the end-link tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25), sloping toward the bracelet; bezel = ring (min of the measured ellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, by rays), outer edge at bezel_z - bezel_outer_dz, dome crest bezel_crest_mm inside the outer edge at bezel_z, window edge at bezel_z - bezel_inner_dz, then a chamfer ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z; rays = aperture.n = 180 (1.5 mm sagitta 0.003 mm at the 20 mm radius is not visible)

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: print, minute track, numerals, rehaut ring and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: hands are the traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm, measured about the pivot in the strip frame of each hand: hour 304.6 deg, minute 63.1 deg, seconds 186.1 deg) as flat polygons; hands_photo = the reference photo projected from the front with its own emission, so lume, Mercedes lines and the green paint show as photographed

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

bracelet.note: bracelet rows and centre-link pieces come from trace.bracelet (rows_mm / pieces_mm); rows follow the silhouette; pieces are rounded rectangles raised piece_lift over the rows; all carry the projected photo (steel_photo material); gap = dark joint between rows
